english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a building, especially a residential or commercial one.

examples.english: There are lots of shops in that building.
examples.jyutping: go2 dung6 lau4 jau5 hou2 do1 gaan1 pou3 tau4

english.note: Use this for a storey or level of a building, as in the third floor.
Use 樓 as the everyday spoken noun for a floor or storey of a building.

examples.english: Our company is on the tenth floor.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 hai2 sap6 lau4

examples.english: My room is on level five.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gaan1 fong2 hai2 ng5 lau4
